functions.role: Build menu definitions with localization ID/style bindings
Dispatch localization event 0x1000015 to the control text helper
Apply localization ID/style to a text object
Allocate a client text object with vtable 00810458
Load original font atlas and 256 five-float metric records

binding_note: Literal definition strings and model names contain spaces, not Ghidra symbol underscores. Static adapter checks each exact button container and its normal visual child at runtime. No normalization is applied; the full original binder is not reconstructed.

dynamic_fields.policy: Do not invent a profile, save timestamp, clock or rebuilt game version.

assets.distribution: Already loose in this local game installation; not inferred archive members. Keep local and ignored.

metrics.encoding: five little-endian float32 values per character
